Topics covered in this PDF

MPSE-004 (Social and Political Thought in Modern India) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Religion and polity in pre-modern India, colonial thought, Muslim thought, Rammohan Roy and Bankim, Moderates and Extremists, Vivekananda and Aurobindo
  • Sir Syed Ahmad Khan, Pandita Ramabai, Gandhi on religion and politics, Ambedkar and untouchability, Nehru's scientific temper, Lohia's socialism

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.
